_: NPC inventory demo: an NPC who CARRIES items. Items in npc.items are added to the actor's inventory — a weapon there is auto-equipped (so this is how you ARM an NPC), and everything drops as loot on death (or can be pickpocketed). Mixes a vanilla ref (iron sword), gold, an in-spec custom weapon (declared AFTER the npc to exercise the forward-ref-safe resolve), and a vanilla potion. IN-GAME TEST: `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn`, find 'Forged Carrier' (a Nord standing in the inn). She should be wielding an iron sword. Pickpocket her (or kill+loot the body) to see the 100 gold, the Steel-ish 'Forged Blade' (custom weapon), and a Restore Health potion in her inventory.

items._: vanilla iron sword (0x012EB7) — the actor's only weapon, so it gets auto-equipped/drawn
in-spec custom weapon, declared after this NPC: forward-ref resolve

weapons._: custom weapon cloned from the vanilla Steel Sword template; referenced by the NPC above
weapons.name: Forged Blade

placements._: Sleeping Giant Inn interior cell (Skyrim.esm:0x0133C6). coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn to reach it.
